item.title: Contratto di ricerca: The Legitimacy of Democratic Systems: The Role of Social Rights (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-07 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Rome
Field: Law / 12/GIUR-05 Diritto costituzionale e pubblico

Contemporary democratic systems are experiencing a period of severe delegitimation, alongside strong signs of weakness in constitutional frameworks and the principles of the rule of law. Within this context of legal uncertainty, a major divisive factor is represented by citizens' dissatisfaction with institutions, particularly regarding the need for equality of treatment and the guarantee of social rights.
